featured_reviews.review_text: Had a fantastic experience at In. Mandarin Asian Kitchen in Kandivali East! The food was absolutely delicious—packed with authentic flavors and great portions. featured_reviews.name: Ankit Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited in.menderian recently and absolutely loved the experience!
We ordered Ramen and Pan-Fried Noodles, and both dishes were spot on.
The Ramen was rich, flavorful, and comforting — the broth had a nice depth with fresh veggies and soft tofu that blended perfectly. It had that warm, satisfying feel you expect from a good bowl of ramen.
The Pan-Fried Noodles were equally impressive — crispy noodles topped with a delicious, slightly spicy gravy loaded with veggies. Great texture contrast and full of flavor.

featured_reviews.name: Lewa Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing experience at Mandarin Asian Kitchen. Their Sri Lankan Sambal Dimsum was delicious, it was the perfect blend of soothing curry with a slight kick to it. We tried the Burmese Khowsuey and Malaysian flat noodles with were extremely delicious and had an authentic taste.

We tried their Panko fried Prawns Futomaki roll, squid butter garlic, and Aflatoon with ice cream which were really flavoursome!!

The service was warm, attentive, and really friendly. We appreciated the care and attention of the staff as well as the owner.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic and flavourful Asian cuisine in Mumbai!
